references.text: The young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah was introduced here, and this is the same person whom the five men are now visiting at Micah's house.
The five men who were sent out to scout the land recognized the voice of the young Levite when they arrived at Micah's house.
Micah had appointed the young Levite as his priest, and he lived in Micah's house.
The expression 'asked how he was doing' (שָׁאַל לְשָׁלוֹם) is a common Hebrew greeting also used here when Joseph asks about his father's well-being.
David also asked about his brothers' well-being using the same expression of greeting and care.
